name: Pluggable Entity View Builder
description: Override an entity type's view builder so each bundle's rendering is handled by a per-bundle PHP plugin class (a method per view mode) instead of preprocess functions and Twig templates.
project_description: Define entity view builders as plugins, defined per bundle. Known in short as PEVB, from Gizra, and relied on in their Drupal-starter. Instead of splitting an entity's rendering across a preprocess function, a Twig template, per-field formatters and alter hooks, PEVB lets you register one plugin class per entity-type/bundle (e.g. `node.article`) with a build method per view mode (`buildFull`, `buildTeaser`). The plugin returns an ordinary render array and has constructor-injected services, so display logic becomes typed, IDE-navigable, testable PHP. It works by overriding the view builder class of selected core entity types (block_content, comment, media, node, taxonomy_term, user, and paragraph when Paragraphs is installed) via hook_entity_type_alter, short-circuiting core's buildMultiple to dispatch to the matching plugin. Ships an example module and a Paragraphs example that demonstrates using paragraphs as composable page-building components (an alternative to Layout Builder). A BuildFieldTrait provides access-checked helpers for reading field values and building images, referenced entities and blocks; PEVB plugins are responsible for their own cache metadata via a managed $this->cacheableMetadata property.
